m.aarti.tek: Again and again I bow to you, Mother; again and again I bow.
m.aarti.pad1: O Ambikā, where is rest for one who does not meditate on you? O Goddess Annapūrṇā, as one takes your name, every task is accomplished.
m.aarti.pad2: Through dissolution, the turn of the ages, other births and other times, your name endures. You create gods and demons; beside you, where are Kṛṣṇa and Rāma?
m.aarti.pad3: Wise four-faced Brahmā and the lovely dark-hued bearer of the discus, Viṣṇu, kiss your feet. Moon-crested Śiva, as your servant, gazes on the exquisite beauty of you, the moon-faced one.
m.aarti.pad4: To goddesses and gods in a pitiable plight, your name is mercy, mercy. Save us, save us, you who love those who come for refuge; your abode is refuge itself.
m.aarti.pad5: Śrīṁ hrīṁ: you are faith; śrīṁ aiṁ: knowledge; śrīṁ klīṁ: the lotus and desire. You are full of radiance and of delusion; you are radiance, full of peace; you grant boons, wanting nothing in return.
